definitions.gloss: summary, overall review, wrap-up, summing up
definitions.explanation: A comprehensive summary or review that brings together the key points of a discussion, project, or period. Often done at the end of a meeting, event, or fiscal period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{総括|そうかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Review this year's activities as a whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{総括|そうかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the meeting, the chair gave a summary.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{総括|そうかつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧。
examples.english: Sum up the project's successes and failures and apply them to the next one.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in business, government, and organizational contexts. Often used at the end of a period or project to review what happened overall. The pattern {総括|そうかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (conduct a review) is standard in formal settings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{要約|ようやく}→要約：14128_youyaku⟧: summary (condensing content)
- ⟦まとめ→まとめ：10506_matome⟧: summary, wrap-up (casual)
- {概括|がいかつ}: general summary, outline

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総括|そうかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: conduct a summary/review
- ⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧{総括|そうかつ}: annual review
- {総括|そうかつ}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: summary report
- {総括|そうかつ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: comprehensive, overall
